instruction.text: Complete the essay excerpt. Fill in the verbs below, using the present progressive.

atoms.b:
A new housing crisis?

The housing market ((is_changing)) rapidly, and the government ((is_trying)) to respond to the new challenges.
House prices ((are_rising)) in most urban areas, making it harder for young families to find affordable homes. Meanwhile, many communities ((are_suffering)) from a lack of public housing.
At the same time, private companies ((are_investing)) heavily in new luxury apartment complexes.
Construction firms ((are_building)) high-rise buildings in almost every major city, but critics say this doesn’t solve the root of the housing crisis.
More and more people ((are_moving)) away from city centers in search of cheaper rent, while others ((are_waiting)) for clearer support policies.
Politicians ((are_discussing)) different strategies, but many feel they ((are_ignoring)) the real needs of ordinary citizens.
Meanwhile, the cost of living ((is_increasing)), and for many, the dream of owning a home is slipping further out of reach.
